Integer, property and control source multiplicities are symbolic path counts (no runtime counters), not invented fixed machine costs. Prepared variants require saved removal and inverse scratch at seenOffset zero; generic variant retains both optional fallbacks. Native word-index width is chosen from the exact geometry word-count range at initialization, not board dimensions. The hot expression remains a direct typed-array indexed load; actual polymorphism/guards and width-specific lowering remain unverified until measured. C19 active union traversal preserves increasing slot order and closure-before-absorption. Unary bit negation/index subtraction is in SUBTRACT; word-address and index additions in ADD; loops/tail/short-circuit selections in TEST/BRANCH. Word count and tail-mask shifts are included; no claim of measured Intel savings. C21 complete support plan replaces basis rebuilding/sorting only. Existing inverse construction, active-owner projection and closure absorption remain; removal is read directly from dense geometry or sparse callback instead of saved removed scratch. Library/frame contract is otherwise unchanged.

isomaxLocalKernel.accountingRule: Every listed unit must be decomposed into bound operations. Unknown lowering/memory/runtime costs remain explicit symbolic terms; no local Negamax operation may fall back to runtime.legacy.addon.body.
isomaxLocalKernel.budgetBoundary: Local CPC-first Negamax search only. Lazy SMP worker startup, teardown, and optional shared-exact-cache traffic remain separate ledgers.

variations.delta: -1 test -1 branch per completed cache-miss node
-2 integer multiplies and -2 geometry field loads per recursive node
removes meta word load/add/shift/and; adds XOR on recursive edges
-1 state field load and -1 typed load per recursive node
removes search-side precursor load/update; accumulation moves to derivation event
removes search-side forced reload/test; accumulation moves to existing forced branches

batchOptimization.policy: Cycle-ledger-first batch; no semantic/performance test between variations. One full qualification after publishing the batch.

isomaxLocalKernel.measurementStatus: stale after restoring intended live-line move-order wiring; rerun whole-IsoMax Fhourstones cycle benchmark before using measuredPhase1CyclesPerNode as current
isomaxLocalKernel.moveOrdering: CPC restrictions first; exact live winning-line contribution descending; prepared geometry actionOrder is tie-break only.

isomaxSystemCycleGraph.invariant: Every add-on unit transitively reachable from the Lazy-SMP Connect4 roots through CALL/CALLBACK edges must be decomposed; no runtime.legacy.addon.body is allowed, and every callback must resolve to concrete units or an explicitly disabled callback.

isomaxRootFrontierCostProfile.scope: Selected root-frontier system including its inherited transitive operation inventory
isomaxRootFrontierCostProfile.binding: All C(op) terms are SYMBOLIC for this Intel runtime. Historical Zen3 fixed cycle constants are not applied. CALL includes separately unresolved boundary/return cost and the callee inventory; waits remain unbounded.
isomaxRootFrontierCostProfile.measuredTotal: Windows QueryProcessCycleTime after minus before, all process threads; setup and whole process retained separately
